args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. The site is clean and simple, which makes it easy to navigate. I appreciated that you included your contact email so visitors can easily reach you. If I could offer a suggestion, it would be great to see more content on the site — perhaps a short bio about who you are, your interests, or what you do. Adding a bit more detail would help visitors get to know you better and make the site feel more personal. Overall, a nice and straightforward personal website. Keep up the good work!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that your blog has a clear personal touch — learning that hiking is your favorite hobby gives it a warm, authentic feel. If I could offer a suggestion, it would be wonderful to see some blog posts about your hiking adventures! Sharing trail recommendations, photos from your hikes, or tips for fellow hikers would make the blog more engaging and give readers more to explore. Overall, it's a nice start to a personal blog, and I'd definitely be interested in reading more about your outdoor experiences. Keep it up!
